facts.fact: Antananarivo's urban commune launched digitalisation of its markets on 7 October 2026: traders are registered on tablets, issued chip-and-QR merchant cards loaded with funds, and commune agents debit dues on payment terminals each day, replacing paper tickets and receipts.
The article describes only the Commune Urbaine d'Antananarivo launching the system, with the first merchant cards distributed on 7 October 2026; it names no other commune.

The commune's market digitalisation was launched on 7 October 2026, with first cards distributed that day; markets are the commune's third revenue source at 7 to 9 billion ariary a year, per its finance director.

systems.platform: tablet registration, chip and QR cards, electronic payment terminals
